title: Mad Love (TV series)
premise_summary: Mad Love is an American sitcom television series created by Matt Tarses that premiered on CBS on February 14, 2011. This multi-camera sitcom starred Jason Biggs, Sarah Chalke, Judy Greer and Tyler Labine, who also is the show's narrator. It was planned as a mid-season replacement during the 2010–11 television season.
